name: Unsewn Undead: Legs and Torso
body:
UNSEWN UNDEAD: LEGS AND TORSO
CR 1/3

XP 135
CE Small undead
Init +4; tremorsense 30 ft.; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+1 size, +2 natural)
hp 9 (2d8)
Fort +0, Ref +0, Will +2
Defensive Abilities Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee spine whip +3 (1d4+1)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 10, Con —, Int 1, Wis 10, Cha 6
Base Atk +1; CMB +1; CMD 13
Feats Improved Initiative
Skills Acrobatics +4
Languages —
SQ undead traits

ABOUT

A severed lower body running on two legs with its exposed vertebral column lashing out from the waist like a segmented bone whip.

It charges forward in narrow corridors, flailing its spine to whip foes while keeping them off balance.
